notes: File transfer car. The bot can now exchange files with its owner in both directions. Outbound: a new send_file tool stages a file (inside the allowed roots) and the reply is followed by the file itself - Telegram sendDocument, Feishu im/v1/files upload plus a file message; every other route degrades to an honest text note naming the file and where it sits, never a silent drop. Inbound: a received Telegram document or Feishu file is saved under state/inbox/ with a sanitized collision-free name and a short note runs the exact same command/pipeline path as a typed message, so the model can read the file and answer about it; oversize is refused before download with one honest locale line. The console gains mycore.allowed_roots - extra directories the file/write tools may touch beyond the built-in repo and temp pair (absent key keeps the old wall byte-identical), validated and normalized on save. send_file registers only on surfaces that can actually deliver it (capability-honest, browser_* style).
